cases.procedure: Probe importlib.util.find_spec('akms_failure_memory') in an interpreter whose sys.path does not contain the package. When it is None the consumer must emit the envelope below and continue; it must not raise, retry, or shell out.

error_contract.note: schemas/provider-result.v1.json pins status to the constant "ok". There is NO schema-legal failure-memory-provider-result/v1 document for a failed or degraded resolution. A consumer must therefore never stamp a non-ok outcome with that schema_version.

summary: The four fail-closed / degrade-safe behaviours of the seam. Every one of these is a contract on the CONSUMER: the package raises a coded akms_failure_memory.errors.FailureMemoryError (or, for the absent-package case, cannot be imported at all) and the consumer must map that to the frozen shape below rather than inventing its own. The refresh/rebuild axis of staleness lives in expected/staleness.json; this file covers the baseline axis only.
